title: Credencial de Firma de Documento
description: Credencial verificable emitida cuando un usuario firma un documento a traves del modulo doc-signing. Registra el tipo de documento, nivel de riesgo, hash del PDF, y la recomendacion del analisis previo.

documentType.description: Type of document being signed (e.g. contract, NDA, power-of-attorney)

riskLevel.description: Risk level determined by document analysis

pdfHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the signed PDF

fileName.description: Original file name of the document

questionsAnswered.description: Number of comprehension questions answered before signing

recommendation.description: System recommendation based on document analysis

flaggedClausesCount.description: Number of clauses flagged for attention during analysis
